test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 13 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In India, which of the following is a report published under MoSPI?

I. Periodic Labour Force Survey

II. Monthly Infrastructure Performance Review Report
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both I and II**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 

__ 
 
• **Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS):** 
 
 
• The **Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS)** is an initiative introduced by the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (**MoSPI**) in **2017**. 
 
• It aims to provide reliable estimates of **Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR)**, **Worker Population Ratio (WPR)**, and **Unemployment Rate (UR)** for both rural and urban areas. 
 
• PLFS is released annually and quarterly to ensure the availability of continuous employment-related statistics in India. *Statement I is correct.* 
 
 
 
• **Monthly Infrastructure Performance Review Report:** 
 
 
• The **Monthly Infrastructure Performance Review Report** is another publication under **MoSPI**. 
 
• It provides a monthly overview of the performance of infrastructure sectors in India, such as **railways, roads, ports, civil aviation, and telecommunications**. 
 
• The report is aimed at tracking the progress of infrastructure projects and identifying bottlenecks in implementation. *Statement II is correct.* 
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI):** 
 
 
• MoSPI is the nodal agency for statistical activities in India and is responsible for conducting surveys and releasing reports on various socio-economic indicators. 
 
• It ensures data transparency, reliability, and accessibility for policymakers and researchers. 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 

__ 
 
• **Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS):** 
 
 
• The PLFS includes data on employment trends across various sectors, including **agriculture, manufacturing, and services.** 
 
• The survey provides a detailed analysis of employment by age group, education level, and gender. 
 
• It also focuses on informal employment, which constitutes a significant portion of India’s workforce. 
 
• Estimates are provided for **both rural and urban areas**, offering a comprehensive picture of India’s labour market. 
 
 
 
• **Monthly Infrastructure Performance Review Report:** 
 
 
• This report is essential for assessing the growth and challenges in infrastructure development. 
 
• It highlights key metrics such as **project completion rates, budget utilization, and delays**. 
 
• It supports government initiatives like **Make in India** and **Atmanirbhar Bharat** by identifying critical areas for intervention. 
 
• Focus is also given to sustainability and environmental impact in infrastructure projects. 
 
 
 
• **Role of MoSPI:** 
 
 
• MoSPI oversees major surveys, including the **Annual Survey of Industries**, **Household Consumer Expenditure Survey**, and **Economic Census**. 
 
• It collaborates with other government departments and international organizations to ensure data consistency and comparability. 
 
• MoSPI also plays a key role in monitoring progress toward the **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)**. 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 

 
 
• **Importance of Labour Market Data:** 
 
 
• Labour market data is critical for addressing unemployment and underemployment issues in India. 
 
• It helps in designing and implementing schemes like **MGNREGA** and **Skill India**. 
 
• Accurate statistics enable evidence-based policymaking to boost economic growth and reduce poverty. 
 
 
 
• **Infrastructure Development in India:** 
 
 
• Infrastructure is a key driver of economic growth, contributing to sectors like **transportation, energy, and communication**. 
 
• Government programs like **Bharatmala** and **SagarMala** aim to enhance connectivity and trade efficiency. 
 
• The Monthly Infrastructure Report aids in tracking the success of such initiatives and ensuring timely completion of projects. 
 
 
 
a1
